artworks.title: Mountain View with Lake
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint. In the foreground, two figures stand on a rocky outcrop among trees. Beyond them is a body of water surrounded by hills. The horizon shows a range of mountains with detailed hatching and lines. The mountains dominate the scene, with their peaks outlined against the sky. The style resembles intricate etching techniques, using varied line work for depth and texture. The color scheme is black and white, emphasizing contrast and detail. The overall effect is a detailed and contemplative scene of natural beauty.

artworks.title: Hamlet with Yorick's Skull
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a full-body portrait standing in a graveyard. The individual is in an upright position with their torso slightly turned, arms crossed over their chest, one hand holding a skull. The person's facial features are partially obscured, with the head slightly tilted, a beard, and long hair. They are dressed in a dark robe or cloak that drapes to the ground. Several large gravestones stand around them, with vegetation, leaves, and branches scattered around. The background is filled with sweeping lines and shading, suggesting an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Watchtower on a Cliff with a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an old tower on a rocky cliff. The tower is positioned on high ground, surrounded by cliffs and dense foliage. The etching technique uses precise lines and cross-hatching to illustrate texture on the rocks and trees. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying black, gray, and white tones. Lush trees with twisted branches fill the foreground, while distant mountains are faintly visible in the background. Birds are depicted flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Rock Outcrop with Shepherds and Goats
artworks.description: The image shows a viewpoint looking slightly down on a large rock formation with human figures nearby. The horizon is not visible, drawing attention to the rock and figures. The piece features fine and detailed brushstrokes, creating a textured appearance in the landscape and rock. The color scheme is monochromatic in black ink, accentuating light and shadow contrast. Two goats are resting in the foreground, with two human figures on the right - one standing and the other reclining. Faintly illustrated birds can be seen in the light sky above.

artworks.title: Stone Bridge over A Mountain Brook
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a stone bridge to the right, several figures seated on it. Buildings surrounded by trees are visible across the bridge. A stream flows under the bridge, with water reflecting light. Trees line the horizon, partially hidden by hills. The artwork is executed in structured brushstrokes resembling etching, with fine lines for textures and shades. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white tones for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Three Sailboats
artworks.description: This etching shows three sailboats on calm water, viewed from above. The horizon is high, with the sails reaching into the sky. No land or structures are visible on the horizon. The style features simple, delicate lines with minimal detail, evoking a tranquil atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white dominating. Birds are lightly sketched in the distance. The boats with lowered sails create reflections on the water's calm surface, depicted with horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Mountain View with Waterfall and Water Birds
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a serene landscape. The perspective is slightly elevated, depicting a tranquil scene. The horizon is not prominently visible, but implied by a mountain range in the distance. The mountains arc gently across the top, with peaks and ridges underlined by cross-hatched brushstrokes. The brushstrokes are intricate and precise, adding movement and depth to the image. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black, white, and grey for contrast. In the foreground, there is a body of water with a bird standing at the edge, reflected in the rippling surface. The ripples in the water are rendered with fine lines for realism. A small waterfall cascades down rocks among lush foliage, enhancing the sense of tranquility. Trees frame the scene, their branches reaching towards the sky, creating a feeling of harmony within the composition.

artworks.title: Boulder with a Shepherd and Goats
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with a large rock formation dominating the lower left. The horizon is obscured by the rising terrain and cliffs, merging into the sky. In the distance, rugged mountains with dramatic lines and intricate hatching are visible. The etching technique includes fine cross-hatching and line work to depict the rough surfaces and contours of the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink creating contrast against the paper and emphasizing details. In the bottom right, a figure sits next to a smoking fire, with smoke curling upwards. A goat rests nearby, adding to the naturalistic elements. Minimal cloud patterns are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: View from a Forest Stream Into a Clearing
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall trees reaching into the sky, with fine etching lines depicting the details of leaves, branches, and tree trunks. The monochrome color palette emphasizes contrast and depth. In the distance, there are figures near a makeshift structure, possibly a hut made of sticks.

artworks.title: Death of Karl V in the Cloister of Saint Just
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior setting with several figures gathered around a large bed or platform. Some figures are kneeling, one holding an object emitting smoke. The motionless figure on the platform is covered by cloth. Additional standing figures are seen in the background, along with architectural details like drapes, arches, and a high vaulted ceiling. Lines are drawn densely and cross-hatched throughout the image.

artworks.title: Women on the Shore
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in traditional garments standing in various poses. The background consists of lightly hatched lines, possibly representing an open sky or background. Some figures are facing each other, while others stand alone. The figures are outlined with thin lines and minimal shading, giving the impression of depth and texture to their clothing. The overall composition conveys a sense of calm observation.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream with Rapids
artworks.description: The image is an etching with a landscape view from a low vantage point, looking towards the mountains in the distance. The horizon line is obscured by the mountainous terrain, drawing the viewer's attention towards the peaks. Tall trees are positioned beyond a river that flows through the middle of the scene, their silhouettes framing the left and right edges. The etching technique used is characterized by fine, intricate lines that create texture and depth, especially evident in the mountain ridges and the foliage. The overall color palette is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: Two Boats With Passengers and Guards
artworks.description: The image shows two boats on a calm body of water with figures in period attire. Some figures are standing while others are sitting. The horizon is low in the composition, with distant outlines of trees and a structure on the left. The etching style uses delicate line work with a stark black ink contrast against a light background. The color palette is monochrome. Close figures wear hats and hold spears, adding to the historical narrative of the scene.

artworks.title: Lowland Marsh with Water Birds
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, emphasizing a tranquil scene near the water. The horizon is depicted at the top of the image, featuring a line of distant trees. The artwork has a sketch-like quality with expressive lines detailing textures in the foliage and reflections in the water. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. The foreground shows rippling water and patches of grass, while birds are visible in the sky above the static trees and calm water.

artworks.title: Valley View, Man with a Donkey and a Dog
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, showing a panoramic view of the terrain. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the composition, with a line of distant hills marking its presence. The artist uses fine, intricate lines reminiscent of etching to depict the elements, creating a detailed texture. On the right side, there are densely packed trees with twisting branches and suggested leaves. A path meanders through the scene, with two small figures traversing the uneven ground. Beyond the path are fields and clusters of vegetation extending towards the distant hills, shaded to convey their slope under a cloudy sky. The entire image is monochrome, with light and shadow created by ink to add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Grotto, Mare aux Biches, Bois de Boulogne
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with a waterfall flowing into a pool of water. Tall trees surround the area, with dappled sunlight filtering through. The waterfall is on a rocky outcrop with foliage. A wooden fence runs along a curving path to the left. The horizon is hidden by dense vegetation. The image is in a sepia tone, emphasizing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Tobit Burying the Dead
artworks.artist: Antoine Watteau, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped figures around a reclining form. The image is sketched with red chalk, showing several tall trees in the background. A vertical monument with intricate details is depicted behind the figures. The figures are engaged in an emotive exchange, with flowing garments and tender postures depicted in soft, fluid lines. The artist's use of light and shadow, primarily through hatching and shading, adds depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Ausable Chasm - Up the River from Table Rock
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow canyon with towering rock walls on either side, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is obscured as the canyon continues into the distance, where the rocks rise steeply and enclose the view. The texture and details of the canyon walls are rugged and layered, creating strong vertical lines. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia, emphasizing the contrast between the rocks and the water at the base of the chasm. Close to us, large flat rocks lead the viewer's gaze along the canyon. In the background, the canyon walls converge and are topped with a sparse growth of trees.

artworks.title: Marion River at Bassett's Camp
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated angle of a rocky riverbed flowing through a dense forest. Trees border the river on both sides, with no visible sky in the high horizon. The trees are a mix of evergreens and leafless trees. Close to us, smooth stones and ripples in the water create a textured pathway. In the middle, a person stands on a rock extending into the riverbed, holding a long stick. The color palette is subdued and monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown and gray. The lighting is soft, casting delicate shadows and enhancing details of the foliage, rocks, and water surface.

artworks.title: Charles Delahaye
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-body portrait. He is seated with his chin resting on his left hand, which is placed on a table. The man has a beard, mustache, and his eyes are looking off-camera. He has voluminous, tousled hair. He is wearing a dark jacket over a light shirt, and there are geometric tools on the table in front of him. The background is blurry with a light-toned surface, possibly a wall or window, and the side of an easel or picture frame is visible. The scene is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Ignis (Fire)
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II, after Willem Buytewech
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.1 x 28.1 cm (7 1/2 x 11 1/16 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows various activities taking place. The horizon, distant landscapes, a smoke plume trail in the sky, people engaging in tasks, a bridge over water, a crane-like structure, open fields, swirling clouds, and smoke are depicted. The black and gray monochromatic color palette lends a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Disputed Meat (La viande disputé)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs interacting. The scene depicts two dogs engaged in an exchange, with one dog tugging at an object in the other dog's mouth. The dogs are detailed with a range of textures and contours. The setting is an open landscape with trees in the background, and fine lines are used to render the foliage. In the upper left corner, there is scripted text and a date.

artworks.title: Ewe Nursing Her Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a goat and two kids. The primary subject is an adult goat standing in the center of the image, with its body positioned in a side profile view. One of the young kids is nestled closely to the adult goat’s front legs, while the other is lying down a short distance behind the adult goat, resting on the grass. The drawing emphasizes the texture of the fur and the contours of the goat’s body. The background consists predominantly of a suggestion of grass that the animals are positioned on. The use of line work captures a naturalistic representation of the scene.

artworks.title: Three Sheep and a Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a group of sheep in a pastoral setting. Three sheep are visible, two standing in the foreground and one sitting on the ground. The sheep are depicted with detailed line work emphasizing the texture of their wool. One sheep is facing left, the other is facing forward, and the ewe on the ground is resting. Surrounding them are grass tufts and broad-leaved plants.
